def convert_last_online(value):
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value
    if value is None:
        return None
    
    s = str(value).strip()
    # remove ordinal suffixes: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th...
    s = re.sub(r'(\d{1,2})(st|nd|rd|th)\b', r'\1', s, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    
    # The sample has no year; target example uses yy=21
    year = 2021
    
    # Parse formats like "9 Aug 10:08"
    for fmt in ("%d %b %H:%M", "%d %B %H:%M"):

            dt = datetime.strptime(s, fmt)
            return datetime(year, dt.month, dt.day, dt.hour, dt.minute)
        except ValueError:
            pass
    
    # Fallback: if year is present
    for fmt in ("%d %b %y %H:%M", "%d %B %y %H:%M", "%d %b %Y %H:%M", "%d %B %Y %H:%M"):

        except ValueError:
